query.content: What function calculates the Ultimate Oscillator momentum indicator from aligned high, low, close, and prior-close price series using short, medium, and long lookback periods of 7, 14, and 28, and returns the oscillator value rounded to two decimal places?

def solution():
    # Define variables
    close_prices = [
        145, 148, 150, 149, 151, 153, 154, 155, 156, 158, 159, 160, 162,
        161, 163, 165, 166, 167, 168, 170, 171, 172, 173, 175, 176, 177,
        178, 180
    ]

    low_prices = [
        140, 145, 148, 147, 149, 150, 152, 153, 154, 155, 156, 157, 159,
        158, 160, 162, 163, 164, 165, 167, 168, 169, 170, 172, 173, 174,
        175, 177
    ]

    high_prices = [
        150, 151, 153, 155, 156, 158, 159, 160, 161, 162, 163, 164, 165,
        167, 168, 169, 170, 171, 172, 174, 175, 176, 177, 179, 180, 181,
        182, 183
    ]

    prior_close_prices = [
        144, 145, 148, 150, 149, 151, 153, 154, 155, 156, 158, 159, 160,
        162, 161, 163, 165, 166, 167, 168, 170, 171, 172, 173, 175, 176,
        177, 178
    ]

    # Calculate buying pressure and true range
    bp_values = []
    tr_values = []

    for close, low, high, prior_close in zip(
        close_prices, low_prices, high_prices, prior_close_prices
    ):
        minimum_price = min(low, prior_close)
        maximum_price = max(high, prior_close)

        bp_values.append(close - minimum_price)
        tr_values.append(maximum_price - minimum_price)

    # Calculate weighted averages for the three periods
    def average_ratio(period):
        buying_pressure = sum(bp_values[-period:])
        true_range = sum(tr_values[-period:])
        return buying_pressure / true_range

    average_7 = average_ratio(7)
    average_14 = average_ratio(14)
    average_28 = average_ratio(28)

    # Calculate the Ultimate Oscillator
    ultimate_oscillator = (
        (average_7 * 4) + (average_14 * 2) + average_28
    ) / 7 * 100

    # Return the value rounded to two decimal places
    return round(ultimate_oscillator, 2)
